_comment: P. aeruginosa high-frequency codon table. Source: Kazusa codon-usage database, taxon 287 (P. aeruginosa PAO1). Each amino acid maps to its most-frequent codon. Used by the tag-DNA reverse-translator if a user wants codon-optimization of a custom tag in v1.1+. The pre-defined tags in tags.py are already optimized; this table is here for extensibility.
